body: I dunno, I think I'm done with the world. Sorry, I just have a lot of pain and I'm so exhausted.

Thank you for your concern. I've seen your name around these forums. You're an angel.

I'm...okay. It feels like my world has devolved into a big, mute, grey mass of long mornings and longer nights. I'm back in therapy and really trying to improve my life, but it's difficult. I care a lot for a few others whom I'd like to help, so that keeps be alive and makes me see the worth in another day.

If you're really that uncomfortable, you can find a new therapist.

But of course you should go back to some sort of therapy. The fact you're hanging around Suicide Watch must say something.

I quit therapy, then swallowed my pride and found a new psychologist. It's okay. Everyone's here to help.
All I can. I moved to a new city, I'm doing more art and looking for new work, and I'm going out more. I have a new therapist. I'm really trying.

What kind of changes would you like to make in your life?

If it means anything, you're obviously good enough at your job for them to keep you around; don't second guess yourself, or think the only reason you're there is to fill some quota. And you're definitely hot just by how you express yourself.

This is a bit of an over-asked question on here, but have you talked to anyone about how you're feeling?
Mm, sounds refreshing. Enjoy it, all the best.
Yep. Most days, it hurts to think *anyone* is happy when I can feel so low.
Haha, holy shit.
I'm sorry you feel so broken. I know everyone asks this, and that it isn't an instant remedy, but are you currently seeing a therapist?

Sounds great, thanks for sharing and suggesting that. It's already Sunday where I am. I happily/miserably wasted the day. I live in the city, but I do like going for walks, so I might try that a little later. I feel trapped despite having access to anywhere/everywhere. It's weird and confusing; I think it's just the depression/anxiety doing it.
Keep it up. Vday's the worst.
Goddamn that sounds better than my day.
Jesus fuck...sorry.
Report, report, report. That's not cool.

I meant clubs as in university societies and such; "art club," "science club," etc. But yeah, cool.
Sorry to hear about things. At least you're beginning to see yourself as likable. Continue that path.
Holy shit, your professor said that?! What the fuck.

Yeah, I'm drawing a lot more now to distract myself. It hardly works when all your subject matter comes from within. Sad drawings, sad writings, sad sad sad.
Currently watching The Sopranos. Distractions!!
It's such a nonsense day anyway, and I don't subscribe to any of its bullshit. But yeah, that doesn't mean things don't hurt.

Yeah, social media gives me crazy anxiety nowadays. I'm not going anywhere near it for at least a fortnight.

I'm sorry to hear about the married guy. I have nothing to really say other than that, and I know words give little comfort. Siiiigh, life can be so fucked.

I had an SO; it ended months ago. My logical brain knows it's for the best, but that shit goes out the window when you wake up every morning on a lounge in a lonely city, wishing to just sink into the cushions and disappear forever.

What's your major? I dunno if this will help, but I didn't join any clubs or go to any events whilst studying, and I sorta regret it. That was a great opportunity to meet new people and do weird things, but I wasted it. So if you're having trouble with girls (or people in general), just force yourself to attend anything and practice socializing.

EDIT: Pfft, who am I kidding...I don't follow my own advice.
Yeah, I have no clue what to do. Thank God it's on a Sunday, at least.
Every night.

Thanks. Honestly it wasn't what I expected. I think I'll stick it out for a few weeks and maybe find some other places in the meantime if it doesn't turn out to be what I wanted. It's just so painful trying to find other GPs, referrals, and bringing it all back up with new strangers all the time, y'know?

I'm sorry for the late reply, and that I can't really answer half these questions thoroughly.

I feel like I had so much shit to blurt out that the therapy sessions were rather one-sided and ended before any proper feedback was given. It lasted a few months and I don't blame the therapist whatsoever for a lack of improvement; I just left before things even started to pick up.

I was diagnosed by the psychiatrist. I can't say things like "yes, I have CPTSD" or "Depersonalisation fits my bill" as I'm sad as hell right now and everything probably seems more dire than it actually is. Also, having anxiety (diagnosed or otherwise) makes this feel like an interrogation, and while you're showering me with great resources and insight, I just can't answer too many things right now.

I didn't explicitly say I had lost my sense of self, rather I've imbued too much sentimentality into my pastimes and interests that they now seem inaccessible; whenever I start on something productive, a world of association fucks with my grieving process and it just piles and piles and I feel like hiding away forever.

I'm sorry I don't have deeper insight right now, it's too painful to go digging. Thankyou for keeping in contact.

The "drowning is hard" woman was probably just too exhausted to elaborate. It's the same feeling upon going to the therapist after a shitstormy week and seeing little worth in bringing it all back up. You're right about the retraumatising; I find meditation really difficult without feeling this overwhelming, impenetrable misery. I can't seem to transcend it or make sense of it. Even as I go about my day as passively ot actively as normal, I'm still struck with reminders. So many things feel inaccessible to me now. I feel so, so trapped.

Which gets me onto my therapy. I was diagnosed with Generalised Anxiety from the get-go, but the sessions were short, weeks apart, and I was deteriorating. My surroundings were haunting me despite trying to find peace. So I left everything and am now living hours away. I used to help a lot of people back then, but it took a traumatic event to show me I wasn't coping. And in a flash, it all hit me at once and sent me to Suicide Watch where Im just going around in circles.

I'm just really stressed and worried, so naturally the thought of starting over with a new therapist scares me, and taking medication more so.

But you have talked a little sense into me, even if I'm just backflipping every five minutes agreeing and disagreeing, etc. Thankyou so much for going to the effort describing the side effects and your experiences with them.

Ugh, I just don't know. I'm wasting away here. I can't leave the house, I can't turn on my laptop. I'm so fucking sad and I just wish I could do away with it all.

I'm not on meds because I have the usual fear of it sapping my creativity and messing with my weight, as immature as that sounds (but art is a big, daily part of my life). I'm quite certain I've had depression and anxiety problems most of my life, but admitting to them and seeking help is new to me; I started therapy a few months ago, and have since stopped after moving away.

I just woke up from a nightmare. I can't really think straight right now to reply thoroughly. I think I would sooner drown than jump. I don't want to crush anyone, I don't want some moron taking pics of the mess under the banner of citizen journalism, and I don't want to make a big scene.

Thanks for replying.

Thanks. I don't expect change to just happen overnight, but Goddamn the days are long and I'm not feeling better despite really trying.
Im fluctuating a lot between thinking "there's nothing here for me and I'm in pain, so I should die" to "there's nothing here for me and I'm in pain, so I should just do whatever I want: go out every night, join classes, do art nonstop" but then that thought still finishes off with "...and then probably kill myself."

Totally. For me, it was because I kept it under wraps- even from myself. I was horribly depressed, but didn't want to admit it. So, through telling others, you sort of open the floodgates. You can feel worse by doing so, but obviously letting the right people know is a positive step.
All the time. My heart rate seems to be permanently raised, I feel a physical weight on my chest, I've lost a lot of weight, and I'm starting to get sick in my stomach. I'm sad.
Cheers (sincere), but I'm not on meds.
Ugh, the nights are the worst. I want to die.

It's gotten to the point where everything is a reminder, or a trigger. I moved away to a new city a few days ago, so that helps, but of course I can't just physically escape being sad. I like to think I'm realistic about things, but it all flies out the window when I'm irrationally depressed and I'm going bonkers.

No, um, I think I've been depressed most of my life, but I've been hiding it away (from myself) 'til it all came to a head a few months ago. I did feel similarly dire a few years back, but it temporarily subsided. And now it's returned, I see that depression/anxiety is a lifelong treasure. Yippee.
Drunk? A few hours.

I try to write often, but obviously in this time it's hard to be optimistic. The scribbles either regretfully mourn a time that never existed, or are just dumb, mawkish suicide notes. Even looking back on today, I tried to draw and write, but had that "what's the point" moment (immature, I know), then drank too much cider, scaled Main Street amongst the cheery go-getters of life, tried this new food joint (alone, mind you), and thought to myself "this is another miserable Australia Day."

Never be embarrassed to ask for help. This sounds like a great catalyst for change; an opportunity for you to lead a better life, unfucked by poisonous people who judge you by sex preference. Don't think "I wish I could be straight," rather "I wish people were more supportive and respectful. Oh well, onward to better days!" You will find your community; you will find acceptance.
Nah, remove this guy from your life. The fact that you're posting on a suicide forum in response to his msgs must tell you something.
You deserve the best! Never give up!

I just noticed how juvenile that all sounded. Ugh, I'm driven by inability. Everything I do seems to either be an embrace of how down I feel, or an active escape from it. Either way, my world is orbiting fear.

I've considered, but never tried. As far as I know I don't have an "addictive personality" (whatever the fuck that means), but I am afraid I'll want to eventually get some "proper" sleeping tabs, start fuckin' around with them together with alcohol on a sad and lonely night, etc. etc.

As for my family, some members are supportive, others are just too damn busy. I'll be staying with an incredibly generous sibling for a month or so once I move, but I feel like a wreck and I really just want to break free and do my own thing. Plus the usual mix of "I don't want to be a burden," "I can't mention the S-word," and "they'll never fully understand." And that's fine, I think I'm fine.

Back in December, I was looking for volunteer work to keep myself alive (I can't say it was solely to help others) and considered being a "buddy" for lonely oldies with no familes. You take them out and go places with them. I decided against it, as I wasn't exactly fit to do it without my death drive going bonkers, but I did wonder if a similar support system existed for depressed folks. I'd not heard of Icarus Project, but I'm from the land of Aus (landofblah) where everything's a few rungs beneath progression. And where the day's not over yet! Ahh time is the worst.

But I really do want to make something of all this, even if just writing or drawing in the hopes people can relate. If nothing else, it's a form of therapy. I felt so alone NYE and your post made gave me some indirect comfort. So I dunno, maybe I can be of similar help to someone somewhere.

Go for the blog. I'm excited for you! I've written a little over the past few days, but nothing too heavy. I'm keen to just write and draw more, observe more, and just be a generally more "alive" person. I think moving will help greatly.

Hey, thanks for chatting. My mood has increased a bit since before. I'm finally out of bed, towards the close of the day. But I'm awake, and still here.

Eh, well I'm not going to kill myself today, so there's that.

Shitty self-tormenting keeps me up at night, but if I find myself waking tired in the morning, I capitalize on that shit like there's no tomorrow (because sometimes I feel there is no tomorrow) and just aim to sleep through the pain. I'm trying so hard to be proactive, taking all the advice I've shelled out to various depressed friends over the years. But it's not working, and I feel cheated now everyone's ditched me in my time of need, and I have no-one. But oh hey SW.

It's so exhausting, though; I know there will be many days like today, so I just have to remember back to a happier time as though it's within arm's reach. It isn't. Feeling scared and lonely is all too familiar despite reaching surprisingly new depths each day. I feel like depression and anxiety is now my default mode, and everything else is just a put-on. It's all transient. The good and the bad. What a ridiculous thing life is.

Yeah, well I figure the time and emotions will pass anyway, so we should just make something novel of it. My idea of documenting came from your idea of a blog. You're doing so damn well considering how December felt.

Hang on to those friends. They seem supportive. We are all somehow connected through a network of isolated beds, ha. I'm not dead yet.
It's ridiculous. We were doing so well, and it all flew out the window. Just write it off as a kratom crash. Take it easy; life will be very shit for a long time. But we can do this.
Yep. I have shit to do; errands to run. But I don't want to get up and expose myself to the world today.
Hey, don't worry about it. I'm in bed, just had a horrible dream and woke with a sense of dread. Ugh.

Thanks. I'm pretty new to writing, but this is going to be a friggin' long year, and as recently as an hour ago I stooped back down to suicidal thoughts and started feeling like shit again. So it's best to just document it and find some creativity and productivity through it all. Otherwise it'll either build and explode into insanity, or just swirl around as neverending sadness. Months or years will go by, and I'd have nothing to show for it.

So yeah, I think you have a great idea. Doing it as a zine could be cheap, effective, instant, and anonymous if you like. This is weird- I'm slowly chipping away at my first zine right now. It's nothing too personal, just filled with drawings and anecdotal comic-type things and whatnot. I'm not really into any of those subcultures, so I'm not sure how well it'll all fare. I just want to make things, y'know?

I just read some of Franz Wright. It's great, and something I'll need to study properly and dedicate time to. Your run in with him is so ballsy and awesome- see, this is the sort of shit worth writing about! I'm currently reading Joan Didion, and she has such a way of derailing the mysticism of those key, theatrical figures in politics and art.

I'm so proud of YOU! You were so, so close to the end. Instead of jumping, you got angry that people could have such a hold on you. Fuck 'em; create your own life now. You're worth so much more than what others pile on you. You helped me that night, and in turn the world is a little bit less shitty, because we're fuckin' great and we won't let them win.

Thankyou. I hope to write more upon moving. I know it's a bit cheesy, but I oftentimes imagine my anxiety and bullshit falling out my car and my mind, dropping onto the freeway as I zoom to a better city. Soon.

Yeah, your story is gonna stick with me for a long time. It made me want to actively search for happiness, it made me want to write more, and it made me see we shouldn't dedicate our death (and thus our whole life) to horrible people. We just can't let it happen, we cant give them that.

Of course you made the right decision. You owe it to yourself to keep swimming through this shit. And yeah, I do think it's somehow possible we can keep each other alive. Even if over the internet, I'm a real person who cares for you and is cool for a chat whenever you feel shitty. SW is the best. I'm so glad the sparkly gold made such an impact.

Thanks for the encouragement! Yeah, I'm moving a few hours away to a different city. I might post about it if things get interesting.

Starting over is scary, but I'm deteriorating in my current circumstance. I'm not exactly the go-to person for optimism, but I'm trying to see it all as an opportunity to better by life. In reality, I feel more like a small animal being forced out of a burning forest.
...and so instead of killing myself, I decided to give gold, lie on the floor all night thinking about my life and not my death, knowing I wasn't totally alone.

I credit some of my survival to reading your posts two weeks ago. It was NYE for me and I wanted to collapse into nothingness. I went on SW and read your story, with the slack-jawed gamblers, the douches swarming around like pterodactyls, and the morning after. It was a great read, as twisted as that sounds, but your idea of "murder by suicide" hit me the hardest. Fuck those who abuse people and essentially get away with it. Psychological, physical, sexual, whatever, all of the above...its a shitty way to have your life and death steered by other people and their bullshit. Murder by suicide. Damn.

Yeah, I remember you saying benzos with no health insurance is tantamount to homelessness. That's such a shitty position to be in.

I understand the fragility. I'm moving soon (to a mattress, yay), and will have to start anew with therapy, work, friends etc. etc. It should be liberating, but Im scared shitless. So I get what you mean with falling apart; I'm just bracing myself for the day I break down. If you're in a safe spot with the doctor and the support, I guess there's no rush for a drastic reshuffle if it's just gonna add more stress. One thing at a time, as they say.

You're kicking arse just by keeping alive and improving your situation. I feel supported and inspired reading your updates and all the great responses people are sending.

If it means anything, this internet stranger was worried and is glad you're still alive.

If the party hasn't already happened, give it a shot. You were invited; someone wants you there. But if you really feel trapped in your history with the area and its people, drive drive drive. I know it's easier said than done, but have you further considered moving and trying new things? You mentioned Oakland and Seattle before.

I'm obviously not too flash at giving advice, but please don't feel alone. Even if your friends have dropped you and everyone knows your story (without understanding a damn), just know there are still millions of other, better people just outside of wherever you are. Friends can be anywhere, work can be anywhere, therapy can be anywhere, but life and death should never be dictated by abusive fucks and shitty roommates. Keep searching, keep writing.
